title: The flowers are cheap but looks nice from far
text:
The flowers are cheap but looks nice from far. I used this for a Mother’s Day event and it looked ok nice at a distance. The flowers are super cheap looking but in bunches all together and from far it looked so so ok nice. This is very overpriced and seller continues to make it more and more expensive. I wished the flowers were better made if they want so much money for this. Also, flowers fall off
a bit to easy
